title: Bimetallic Nanoparticles confined in an N-Doped Graphitic Carbon Shell: A High-Performance Trifunctional Catalyst for Efficient Water Splitting
content:

Understanding the structure-property relationship of materials and identifying the active centers responsible for electrochemical water splitting is essential for designing high-performance electrocatalysts. This study presents the synthesis of nickel-titania (Ni-TiO2)...
